# TidBit — The Antidote to Brainrot

> An educational, distraction-free Android application that transforms short-form video into enduring knowledge through synchronized AI tutoring with Bud, an integrated digital library (BookNest), cognitive games, and zero advertising algorithms.

## Key Information
- **Name**: TidBit
- **Category**: Educational Mobile Application (Android)
- **Minimum Operating System**: Android 8.0 (API Level 26) through Android 15+
- **Architectures**: ARM64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64
- **License / Cost**: Free, Zero In-App Advertisements, Zero Tracking
- **Release Package**: Standalone APK (~10 MB)
- **Download URL**: https://github.com/TheGaurav09/tidbit-releases/releases/latest/download/tidbit-app-release.apk
- **Official Repository**: https://github.com/TheGaurav09/tidbit-releases

## Five Core Disciplines
1. **High-Yield Educational Shorts (Reels)**: 60-second bite-sized vertical video lessons taught by vetted creators and educators, buffered with an ExoPlayer player pool for instantaneous, lag-free playback.
2. **Bud AI Study Assistant**: Context-aware AI tutor that transcribes video audio in real time, generates 3-question active recall checks, and creates spaced repetition concept flashcards.
3. **BookNest E-Reader & Audiobooks**: Distraction-free digital library with offline reading support, customizable typography, and high-fidelity neural audiobooks narrated by Unreal Speech TTS.
4. **Cognitive Apps & Games Hub**: Daily brain workout modules including Vocabulary (Spelling Bee, Word Match), Math speed drills, Computer Science quizzes, and Sudoku.
5. **Yaad Notes & Offline Vault**: Markdown study notes and flashcard decks stored with on-device hardware-backed keystore encryption.

## Privacy & Safety Charter
- Zero third-party ad networks or tracking SDKs.
- Zero data brokering or selling of student behavioral patterns.
- Secure token storage using Android EncryptedSharedPreferences.
